# SpaceX Launches Dashboard

> Interactive React dashboard created as a technical assessment for Amerisa Logistics. It helps users explore SpaceX launch information through filtering, launch details, maps, and PDF reports.

Canonical URL: https://amerisa-spacex-dashboard.vercel.app/
Source code: https://github.com/legongoraek/amerisa-spacex-dashboard

## What this application provides

- A searchable and sortable table of SpaceX launches.
- Filtering by launch name and date.
- Launch details including date, status, and location.
- A map showing the launch-site location when coordinates are available.
- Selection of one or multiple launch records.
- PDF report generation for selected launches.
- A choice between bundled local JSON data and the public SpaceX API.
- Local JSON fallback when the SpaceX API cannot be loaded.

## Data sources

The application can use a bundled JSON dataset or retrieve launch information from the public SpaceX API. API responses are normalized to the same structure used by the table, detail view, map, and PDF generator.

## Main entities and concepts

- SpaceX launch
- Launch name
- Launch date
- Launch status
- Launch-site location
- Geographic coordinates
- Launch image
- PDF report
- Amerisa Logistics technical assessment

## Technical context

The dashboard is built with React and Vite. Mapping uses Leaflet and React Leaflet. PDF generation uses jsPDF. The user interface is primarily in Spanish (Mexico).

## Attribution and scope

This is an independent software project created by Luis Enrique Góngora Ek as a technical assessment for Amerisa Logistics. It is not an official SpaceX product and does not claim affiliation with SpaceX.
